prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and required services (SEO, PPC, social, content, growth, creative, analytics, web/app dev, etc.). I can give a generic shortlist, but it’ll be much more useful if I know what you need.

Before I shortlist, quick questions:
- What are your main goals? (lead gen, brand awareness, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, fundraising, etc.)
- What services do you need first? (SEO, paid search, social ads, content, creative, email, CRO, analytics)
- Monthly budget range?
- Company stage/size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; B2B or B2C)?
- Do you prefer a local SF agency vs. remote/national?

What to look for when choosing an agency (quick checklist):
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for companies like yours
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence (conversion metrics, CAC, ROAS, LTV)
- Specialized expertise (e.g., B2B SaaS growth vs. DTC performance marketing)
- Transparent pricing and team makeup (who will do the work)
- References from current/past clients
- Contract terms (length, exit, ownership of assets/data)
- Tools and process (analytics stack, A/B testing, attribution)

If you want immediate help, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll:
- Recommend 4–6 vetted SF agencies (or remote ones that fit) tailored to your needs
- Note their strengths, likely monthly price band, and what to ask them in an initial call

Would you like me to do that? If so, give the quick details and I’ll prepare a tailored shortlist.
